messages.text:
The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed: best scores update only for fewer moves, and unfinished sizes show `Best: none`. Added regression coverage for size changes and reloads.

Validation passed: typecheck, build, 140 unit checks, and 76 browser journeys. One visual test exceeded 30 seconds; its assertions passed separately in 30.9 seconds. Changed files pass formatting; 13 untouched files have existing formatting issues.
